summary: Stale-registration re-dispatch is dead in production: _dispatch_infra_drain's pre-spawn existence re-check aborts on the PRE-EXISTING stale issue-<N>.json; test 21 stubs the helper, masking it.
_live_session_ids() returns empty set (not None) on daemon outage; once stale re-dispatch is fixed, a daemon flap mid-pass can false-stale a LIVE proposed-parked session and double-spawn.
